keyword.zh: 电动40和电动50混凝土泵的区别

title.zh: 电动40和电动50混凝土泵有何不同

description.en: Electric 50 adds a 24 mm stone distance row and prints 55 kW, 26 m³/h and 30 MPa against Electric 40.
description.zh: 电动50多了一行 24 mm 石子距离，并印 55 kW、26 m³/h、30 MPa，与电动40不同。

h1.zh: 电动40和电动50混凝土泵有何不同

directAnswer.en: Electric 40 and Electric 50 are Hebei Pinjin Machinery concrete pumps built in Xingtai. Electric 40 prints 45 kW, 21 m³/h, 23 MPa, fine-stone 120 m / 360 m and aggregate-13 40 m / 120 m. Electric 50 prints 55 kW, 26 m³/h, 30 MPa, fine-stone 150 m / 350 m, 13 mm stone 80 m / 240 m and 24 mm stone 60 m / 180 m. Hopper volume is 0.4 m³ on both pages.
directAnswer.zh: 电动40和电动50是河北品锦机械在邢台制造的混凝土泵。电动40印 45 kW、21 m³/h、23 MPa、细石 120 m / 360 m、13骨料 40 m / 120 m。电动50印 55 kW、26 m³/h、30 MPa、细石 150 m / 350 m、13 mm 石子 80 m / 240 m、24 mm 石子 60 m / 180 m。料斗两边都是 0.4 m³。

heading.en: Where Electric 40 and Electric 50 print different values
heading.zh: 电动40和电动50哪些数值不同

body.en: Motor power: Electric 40 prints 45 kW; Electric 50 prints 55 kW. Theoretical output: Electric 40 prints 21 m³/h; Electric 50 prints 26 m³/h. Max. outlet pressure: Electric 40 prints 23 MPa; Electric 50 prints 30 MPa. Hydraulic pump: Electric 40 prints Kawasaki 112; Electric 50 prints Kawasaki 140. Dimensions: Electric 40 prints 3900 × 1500 × 1600 mm; Electric 50 prints 4100 × 1600 × 1600 mm. Main unit weight: Electric 40 prints 2300 kg; Electric 50 prints 2800 kg. The same printed value on a shared label: Hopper capacity is 0.4 m³ on both pages. These are printed cells on the Hebei Pinjin Machinery pages for concrete pumps made in Xingtai. They are not a calculated conversion from one model to the other.
body.zh: 电机功率：电动40印 45 kW；电动50印 55 kW。理论输送量：电动40印 21 m³/h；电动50印 26 m³/h。最大出口压力：电动40印 23 MPa；电动50印 30 MPa。液压泵：电动40印 Kawasaki 112；电动50印 Kawasaki 140。外形尺寸：电动40印 3900 × 1500 × 1600 mm；电动50印 4100 × 1600 × 1600 mm。整机重量：电动40印 2300 kg；电动50印 2800 kg。同一标题下数值相同的有：料斗容积两边都是 0.4 m³。以上是河北品锦机械在邢台混凝土泵页面上印出的格子，不是把一台机器换算成另一台。

heading.en: Cells that exist on only one of these pumps
heading.zh: 只在其中一台泵上出现的格子

body.en: Electric 40 prints cells that Electric 50 does not: Fine-stone pumping (H / V) 120 m / 360 m; Aggregate-13 pumping (H / V) 40 m / 120 m. Electric 50 prints cells that Electric 40 does not: Fine-stone conveying (H / V) 150 m / 350 m; 13 mm stone (H / V) 80 m / 240 m; 24 mm stone (H / V) 60 m / 180 m. A blank or missing label is not filled from the other concrete pump.
body.zh: 电动40有、电动50没有的行：细石输送（水平/垂直） 120 m / 360 m；13骨料输送（水平/垂直） 40 m / 120 m。电动50有、电动40没有的行：细石输送（水平/垂直） 150 m / 350 m；13 mm石子（水平/垂直） 80 m / 240 m；24 mm石子（水平/垂直） 60 m / 180 m。缺了的标题不能用另一台混凝土泵来补。

heading.en: How to read the two pages without merging them
heading.zh: 怎样分开阅读这两个页面

body.en: Electric 50 is not Electric 40 with a new badge. It prints a third stone row and a different hydraulic-pump name. Open /en/products/electric-40-concrete-pump/ for Electric 40 and /en/products/electric-50-concrete-pump/ for Electric 50. Hebei Pinjin Machinery builds these concrete pumps in Xingtai, Hebei. The number in a commercial name is not a licence to copy output, pressure or distance. If a job needs a figure this pair does not print, use the contact page rather than inventing a bore, stroke or price.
body.zh: 电动50不是换了铭牌的电动40。它多印一行石子距离，液压泵名称也不同。看电动40请打开 /zh/products/electric-40-concrete-pump/，看电动50请打开 /zh/products/electric-50-concrete-pump/。河北品锦机械在河北邢台制造这些混凝土泵。商品名里的数字不能用来抄产量、压力或距离。如果工况需要这对机型没有印出的数字，请走联系页，不要编造缸径、行程或价格。

question.en: Does Electric 40 print the same motor power as Electric 50?
question.zh: 电动40和电动50的电机功率一样吗？

answer.en: No. Electric 40 prints 45 kW. Electric 50 prints 55 kW. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other.
answer.zh: 不一样。电动40印 45 kW。电动50印 55 kW。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。

question.en: Does Electric 40 print the same theoretical output as Electric 50?
question.zh: 电动40和电动50的理论输送量一样吗？

answer.en: No. Electric 40 prints 21 m³/h. Electric 50 prints 26 m³/h. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other.
answer.zh: 不一样。电动40印 21 m³/h。电动50印 26 m³/h。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。

question.en: Does Electric 40 print the same max. outlet pressure as Electric 50?
question.zh: 电动40和电动50的最大出口压力一样吗？

answer.en: No. Electric 40 prints 23 MPa. Electric 50 prints 30 MPa. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other.
answer.zh: 不一样。电动40印 23 MPa。电动50印 30 MPa。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。

question.en: Why is fine-stone pumping (h / v) missing on Electric 50?
question.zh: 为什么电动50没有细石输送（水平/垂直）？

answer.en: The Electric 50 page does not print that label. Electric 40 prints 120 m / 360 m. Leave the missing cell blank. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not publish a rule for copying it across concrete pumps.
answer.zh: 电动50这一页没有印这个标题。电动40印的是 120 m / 360 m。缺的格子保持空白。河北品锦机械没有公布把该格抄到另一台混凝土泵上的规则。
